coaching.headline: We won majors 22-19 and every fight we took, 4-0, but still lost on towers 4-9.
coaching.team: We won the duo lane clean — first blood at 2.7, first Fangtooth, zero duo deaths before 10 to their three — and two of five role matchups (Murdock, Shinbi) read favorably for us at some point. The 18-minute teamfight, traded 2-2 with Murdock and Khaimera already dead, cost our first tower at 18.8. We answered by winning the 22.5-minute fight 2-0 and taking Fangtooth, but they took an Outer Tower in the same window. The game turned in the 27-to-35-minute stretch. Shinbi's solo catch at 27.4 cost an Inner Tower, Morigesh's catch at 31.7 cost four structures in a minute, and Khaimera's three late solo catches fed the Primal Fangtooth, an Inhibitor, and the Core. We still won the last fight, at 35.7, 2-1, but the Core had already fallen. Majors finished 22-19 ours, fights 4-0 ours, towers 4-9 theirs.
coaching.whatShiftedIt: Five solo catches from 27 to 35 minutes — Shinbi once, Morigesh once, Khaimera three times — each fed a structure or major while the team kept winning the fights around them; that pattern, not any single fight, turned the 22-19 major lead into the loss.
coaching.whatWorked: Our duo lane won clean: first blood at 2.7, first Fangtooth, and zero duo deaths before minute 10 to their three.

deepDive.verdict: We won the majors and the fights, but five solo deaths from Shinbi, Morigesh, and Khaimera between 27 and 35 minutes let seven structures — four towers, two inhibitors, and the core — fall behind us, after two Outer Towers had already gone at 18.8 and 23.5.

causes.claim: A single solo death at 31.7 cost four structures in under a minute — the costliest decision point of the game.
causes.receipt: Morigesh was caught alone by The Fey at 31.7; the structure ledger shows her dead before the Outer Tower (31.8) fell with no fight nearby, and dead again — alongside Khaimera — before the Inner Tower (32.1) and both Inhibitors (32.3 and 32.6) fell near the 33-minute fight.

causes.claim: Khaimera was caught alone three times after minute 29, each one directly preceding a major or structure loss.
causes.receipt: Khaimera's 29.4 solo death preceded the uncontested Primal Fangtooth at 30.5; his 32.4 solo death preceded an Inhibitor at 32.6 and an Inner Tower at 33.5; his 34.6 solo death preceded the Core falling at 36.1.

causes.claim: Shinbi was caught alone by Aurora four times, and the fourth, at 27.4, cost the Inner Tower directly.
causes.receipt: Shinbi was caught alone by Aurora at 5.4, 10.3, 12.2, and 27.4; the 27.4 catch ties directly to the Inner Tower falling at 27.9, and he never built magic resist against a comp that was three-fifths magical.

causes.claim: Two of our four won fights were never cashed, and two enemy majors were taken with our whole roster alive.
causes.receipt: We won 4 fights but only converted 2 into a prize, missing conversions at 15.7 and 35.7; the enemy also took the Fangtooth at minute 17 and the Primal Fangtooth at minute 30 completely uncontested, with nobody of ours dead at the time.

deepDive.ledger: Their first tower fell at 18.8 after the 18-minute teamfight, which we traded 2-2 with Murdock and Khaimera already dead. We then won the 22.5-minute fight 2-0 and took Fangtooth, but they took an Outer Tower in the same window — the win never bought map control. Shinbi's solo catch at 27.4 cost the Inner Tower at 27.9, and their Genesis Core fell in the same window, with only Shinbi dead. Morigesh's solo catch at 31.7 cost four structures in a minute: the Outer Tower (31.8), Inner Tower (32.1), and both Inhibitors (32.3, 32.6), the last two with Khaimera also dead. The 33-minute teamfight, opened a body down after Khaimera's death 37 seconds earlier, cost another Inner Tower at 33.5 as Murdock and Narbash also fell. Khaimera's last solo catch at 34.6 doomed the Core, which fell at 36.1 even though the final fight, at 35.7, was won 2-1.
deepDive.theCall: At 31.7, with us already down two Outer Towers and an Inner Tower, Morigesh needed to group instead of roaming alone — that one catch by The Fey fed four structures (31.8-32.6) in under a minute, turning a close structure count into the decisive stretch that ended 4-9.
deepDive.rule: After losing a tower or ally, group before the next objective — don't roam solo down a structure.

threats: Chain-CC risk (3 hard-CC abilities, ~2.5s of lockdown): Riktor Riplash (pull), Riktor Shock Therapy (silence 0.8s), Riktor Skewer (suppress 1.25s). Don't group tight into it — stagger the engage and hold mobility/cleanse for the key one.
synergy: Little hard CC on our side — we can't force a pick. Play for poke/objectives and punish their cooldowns, don't flip coin-toss 5v5s.
We have sustain (Narbash) — favor the longer fight where our heals out-grind them.
Strong AoE/teamfight kit — group at choke points and fight on top of objectives.

ourKits.combo: Static Trap root → Buckshot → Hot Pursuit AS → Long Arm of the Law global snipe
ourKits.winCondition: trap for the root, then out-range with Shots Fired and finish with the global ult
ourKits.passive: every 5th basic is a long-range bonus shot
ourKits.playWith: frontline/peel to protect his low mobility
ourKits.playAgainst: almost no escape — engage past the trap and he dies

ourKits.combo: Thunk stun → March! speed → Song heal aura → Crash Bang Boom! AoE slow ult
ourKits.winCondition: engage with Thunk and group-buff the team through fights
ourKits.playWith: a dive team that rides his speed and heal
ourKits.playAgainst: dodge/cleanse Thunk; he's low-damage — kill his carry through the aura

ourKits.combo: Mark a target → Hive slow → Swarm reposition → Curse execute-burst ult
ourKits.winCondition: Mark + Curse a squishy and delete them with %max-HP Pestilence
ourKits.playWith: setup that holds her marked target
ourKits.playAgainst: she's squishy with one escape (Swarm) — dive after it's used; spread vs Hive

ourKits.combo: Rushing Beat dashes → Line Tempo wolves → Circle Rhythm shield → All-Kill! wolfpack ult
ourKits.winCondition: stack Track and unleash All-Kill! in a grouped fight
ourKits.playAgainst: spread vs the wolfpack; she's squishy without her shield up

ourKits.combo: Ambush leap → Unleash AS → Cull stun, Invigorate to cleanse+heal
ourKits.winCondition: stick on one target, stun with Cull and out-sustain via Spirit Regen
ourKits.playWith: follow-up burst inside his Cull stun
ourKits.playAgainst: ANTI-HEAL is mandatory — it guts his whole kit; kite the leap and CC through Invigorate

enemyKits.combo: Vortex Grenade → Vaporize pierce → Rocket Dash reposition → Ventilate ult
enemyKits.winCondition: reposition with Rocket Dash and unload Ventilate from safety
enemyKits.passive: abilities grant AS + a triple-shot next basic
enemyKits.playWith: a frontline to create his free-fire window
enemyKits.playAgainst: he's mobile but squishy — CC through the dash, then burst

enemyKits.combo: Boreal Sweep slow → Hoarfrost root → Glacial Charge engage → Cryoseism stun ult
enemyKits.winCondition: chain frost CC (slow→root→stun) to lock the fight down
enemyKits.playWith: burst that converts her long CC chain into kills
enemyKits.playAgainst: she's a CC battery — cleanse/QSS the Cryoseism stun; spread to avoid the chain

enemyKits.combo: Riplash pull → Shock Therapy silence → Skewer suppress ult
enemyKits.winCondition: pull a target in and chain silence+suppress for a guaranteed kill
enemyKits.playWith: burst that deletes his pulled/suppressed target
enemyKits.playAgainst: respect Riplash range — stay spaced; cleanse/QSS the suppress

enemyKits.combo: Evade in → Barricade block → Spear of Nyr (execute <20%) → Coliseum ult arena
enemyKits.winCondition: trap a target in Coliseum and out-duel with stacked Gladiator
enemyKits.playWith: a team that joins him inside the Coliseum
enemyKits.playAgainst: don't fight him in his arena — disengage; burst through Barricade's window

enemyKits.combo: Bramble Patch slow → Harvest Nettles stacks → Untamed Growth DoT → Fly Trap pull ult
enemyKits.winCondition: Fly Trap a clumped team and detonate AoE on the pull
enemyKits.passive: takedowns spawn growths + grant move speed
enemyKits.playWith: engage that clumps for her Fly Trap
enemyKits.playAgainst: spread out vs the pull; she's squishy — dive her
